Nach einer Umfrage des ifo Instituts berichten Industrieunternehmen wieder häufiger von Problemen bei der Versorgung mit Vorprodukten. Inland Cargo Shipping on Europe's Most Important River Railway wagons pass chemical tanks at the BASF SE plant in Ludwigshafen, Germany, on Thursday, Aug. 13, 2020. Around 30% of Germanys coal, iron ore and natural gas is transported along the river, where factories are set up to take deliveries for just-in-time manufacturing. Photographer: Alex Kraus/Bloomberg via Getty Images
